title: As Soon As We Arrive
goal: Say what you will do as soon as something happens, with en cuanto, tan pronto como and apenas + the present subjunctive.
grammar: en cuanto, tan pronto como and apenas + subjunctive

sections.title: Unit 7: Time Clauses Looking Ahead
body: At B2 you plan, promise and warn: you say what you will do when something else has happened. This unit is about the time clauses that look ahead, and the choice between the indicative (a fact) and the subjunctive (something still to come).

You will practise en cuanto, tan pronto como and apenas, hasta que, mientras, siempre que and cada vez que, and antes de que and después de que. The unit ends with a short text about the Colombian writer Gabriel García Márquez and his novel El coronel no tiene quien le escriba.

items: I can say what I will do as soon as something happens, using en cuanto, tan pronto como and apenas with the present subjunctive.
I can tell a future event (subjunctive) from a past or habitual one (indicative).
I can use the new words for plans and arrangements.
